regional_profile_name: ThinkHazard! & GFDRR Regional Disaster Risk Assessment - Middle East
assessment_framework: World Bank / Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery (GFDRR: https://www.gfdrr.org/) / UNDRR (https://www.undrr.org/) / ThinkHazard! (https://thinkhazard.org/)

Turkey.primary_tectonic_setting: Anatolian Plate convergence between Arabian, African and Eurasian plates; North & East Anatolian Strike-Slip Faults

Earthquake.driver: North & East Anatolian Fault Zones (M7+ frequency)

Wildfire.driver: Mediterranean & Aegean pine forest ecosystems under climate heating

River Flood.driver: Black Sea and Marmara steep basin precipitation

Landslide.driver: Pontic Mountains and eastern Anatolian steep terrain

Iran.primary_tectonic_setting: Arabian-Eurasian continental collision zone; Zagros Fold-and-Thrust Belt, Alborz Fault, Kopeh Dagh, Central Iranian micro-continents

Earthquake.driver: Zagros and Alborz active thrust and strike-slip faults

Flash Flood.driver: Arid basin convective rainstorms and rapid runoff

Drought.driver: Chronic multi-year aridification and groundwater depletion

Extreme Heat.driver: Persian Gulf and Khuzestan subtropical high persistence

Iraq.primary_tectonic_setting: Mesopotamian foreland basin adjacent to the Zagros thrust belt

Drought.driver: Tigris-Euphrates upstream flow reduction and prolonged precipitation deficits

Extreme Heat.driver: Summer temperatures routinely exceeding 50°C in southern plains

Extreme Dust Storm.driver: Degraded marshlands and bare soil Haboob generation

River Flood.driver: Tigris and Euphrates spring snowmelt surges

Syria.primary_tectonic_setting: Northern Dead Sea Transform & Palmyride fold belt

Earthquake.driver: Dead Sea Transform / Ghab / Yammouneh fault system

Lebanon.primary_tectonic_setting: Dead Sea Transform restraining bend (Yammouneh, Roum, Serghaya, Mount Lebanon thrust)

Earthquake.driver: Yammouneh fault strike-slip & Mount Lebanon offshore thrust

Wildfire.driver: Mount Lebanon and Chouf pine and oak forests

Jordan.primary_tectonic_setting: Dead Sea Transform eastern flank & Wadi Arabah

Water Scarcity & Drought.driver: Ranked among the top 5 most water-stressed countries globally

Flash Flood.driver: Steep wadi canyons draining to Dead Sea and Jordan Valley

Earthquake.driver: Jordan Valley & Wadi Arabah strike-slip faults

Extreme Heat.driver: Eastern badia and Jordan Valley summer heat

Israel.primary_tectonic_setting: Dead Sea Transform (Sinai sub-plate / Arabian plate boundary)

Wildfire.driver: Judean Hills, Carmel and Galilee Mediterranean WUI

Flash Flood.driver: Judean Desert, Negev, and coastal micro-basins

Extreme Heat.driver: Sharav desert winds and summer heat domes

Earthquake.driver: Jordan Valley, Dead Sea basin, and Carmel fault

State of Palestine.primary_tectonic_setting: Central Judean/Samarian anticlinorium adjacent to the Jordan Rift Valley

Earthquake.driver: Proximity to Dead Sea Transform & Jericho fault segment

Flash Flood.driver: Steep eastern slopes descending to the Jordan Valley

Egypt.primary_tectonic_setting: Northeast African craton, Gulf of Suez rift & Gulf of Aqaba rift

Flash Flood.driver: Sinai Peninsula and Red Sea Hills wadi torrents

Extreme Heat.driver: Subtropical desert climate with 45°C+ summer peaks

Coastal Flood & Subsidence.driver: Nile Delta coastal sea level rise vulnerability

Earthquake.driver: Gulf of Aqaba, Gulf of Suez, and Dahshur faults

Saudi Arabia.primary_tectonic_setting: Arabian Shield, Red Sea oceanic rift margin & Cenozoic volcanic fields (Harrats)

Extreme Heat.driver: Interior Rub' al Khali and coastal Tihamah extreme heat (50°C+)

Flash Flood.driver: Asir and Hijaz mountain wadis draining towards western coastal plain

Extreme Dust Storm.driver: Desert shamal winds and active dunes

Volcanic Unrest.driver: Harrat Rahat, Harrat Lunayyir active volcanic fields

Yemen.primary_tectonic_setting: Afar Triple Junction, Gulf of Aden rift & Yemen highlands

Tropical Cyclone.driver: Arabian Sea cyclogenesis striking Socotra and southern coast

Flash Flood.driver: Torrential monsoon rains descending rugged western highlands

Earthquake.driver: Red Sea / Gulf of Aden extensional rift faulting

Drought.driver: Severe water table depletion in Sana'a and highland basins

Oman.primary_tectonic_setting: Arabian plate southeastern margin, Oman Mountains (oPHIOLITE), Makran Subduction Zone

Tropical Cyclone.driver: Direct exposure to Arabian Sea tropical cyclones (e.g. Gonu, Mekunu)

Flash Flood.driver: Hajar Mountains steep wadis flooding coastal Batinah plain

United Arab Emirates.primary_tectonic_setting: Northeastern Arabian platform bordering the Oman Mountains and Persian Gulf

Extreme Heat.driver: Persian Gulf high humidity and 48°C+ summer ambient temperatures

Flash Flood.driver: Mesoscale convective cloudbursts over urbanized flat terrain and Hajar foothills

Extreme Dust Storm.driver: Northwesterly Shamal winds transporting Iraqi dust plumes

Flash Flood.driver: Sudden torrential cloudbursts overwhelming flat urban drainage

Qatar.primary_tectonic_setting: Qatar arch in the Arabian Gulf

Bahrain.primary_tectonic_setting: Low-lying archipelago in the Gulf of Bahrain

Coastal Inundation.driver: Low-lying topography vulnerable to storm surges and sea-level rise

Cyprus.primary_tectonic_setting: Cyprus Arc (African-Anatolian plate boundary) & Troodos Ophiolite

Earthquake.driver: Cyprus Arc subduction and strike-slip faults

Wildfire.driver: Troodos mountain pine forests under prolonged Mediterranean summer drought
